title: Exact scoped capability discovery
summary: A capability is an observed, versioned claim for one provider, account, surface and action, with declared mechanical limits; it does not grant organisational permission.
invariants: Fail closed without an exact matching current capability for new dispatches.
Provider-wide capability is not transferable to all accounts or surfaces.
Re-check scope for each new request; return immutable recorded receipts for idempotent replay, even after subsequent revocation.
A capability revision/evidence string is not proof of current platform authorization unless the live resolver validates it.

provenance.claim: Dev5 regression coverage (source-level provenance, not runtime claim)
